intro: Mending Old Wounds is an avenue of reconciliation for outcasts and corsairs who have run afoul of the Steamwheedle Cartel in Ratchet. Overseen by Mupsi Shacklefridd outside the port town, this repeatable donation allows disgraced travelers to buy back standing by treating wounded sailors battered by the Bloodsail Buccaneers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You'd better think twice before setting foot in Ratchet, friend! Words been getting around of your dirty deeds.

You're in luck though, a ship just arrived with many wounded from an encounter with the Bloodsail Buccaneers. This is your chance to prove you're not a complete scoundrel. Lend us a hand by bringing linen cloth for bandages and empty vials for potions.
